_about: A voice profile: one writer's measured habits and their own corrections, used by voicecheck.py --voice when a text goes out IN THAT PERSON'S NAME. This file is a neutral template with made-up values. Copy it OUTSIDE the skill folder (it is personal data), measure the real numbers with the 'voice' brief in references/research/briefs.md, and point HUMAN_VOICE_PROFILE at your copy. Every key is optional: a habit you leave out is not checked.
name: the example writer

habits._about: Checked in chat and post modes only. 'sev' is LOW/MED/HIGH; keep them LOW or MED unless the writer asked for the rule, because the thread can overrule an average. 'why' is shown as the fix; {name} is replaced by the profile name.

no_final_stop.why: {name} ends chat messages on the last word (example: 9 in 10 of their messages)

no_semicolon.why: {name} almost never uses a semicolon; split the sentence

chat_max_words.why: {name}'s chat median is about 12 words; say it in two short lines

no_formal_signoff.why: {name} does not sign off in chat; just stop

rules._about: The writer's own corrections, per language, checked in every mode. Add each one the day they make it, with the date in 'fix'. 're' is matched against the lower-cased draft.
